/value/combat_types/1/description.value: Using <color=#f29e38ff>Ice</color> attacks to trigger <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Break</color> will deal Ice DMG and <color=#f29e38ff>Freeze</color> the target, immobilizing the enemy and dealing Ice additional DMG.

/value/combat_types/4/description.value: Using <color=#f29e38ff>Quantum</color> attacks to trigger <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Break</color> will deal Quantum DMG and apply the <color=#f29e38ff>Entanglement</color> effect, delaying the enemy's action and dealing Quantum Additional DMG to the affected enemy at the start of the next turn. When the enemy is hit, this extra DMG will increase.
